## Production Path
Implement the complete Flow X13 boot-profile invariant end to end. Base is nvidia-disabled through a Flow-only !config.isSpecialisation wrapper around pinned nixos-hardware common-gpu-nvidia-disable. Child is nvidia-enabled and has none of that additive policy. Existing custom NVIDIA module is the sole enabled-policy owner. Niri uses its supported render-drm-device setting with NVIDIA rendering and AMD available for scanout. supergfxd is false and @saved remains unchanged.

- flake.nix

- Add/pin nixos-hardware without globally importing it.
- Guard exact upstream disable module at the Flow extraModules boundary with !config.isSpecialisation.
- Keep base custom NVIDIA flags false; define only nvidia-enabled child selector, tags, forced typed flags, and enabled NIRI_CONFIG in the host.
- Delete local partial udev policy; set supergfxd false; preserve loader timeout/default text.
- Make Flow enabled NVIDIA policy sync/render-primary, reverse-sync/offload false, fine-grained false, correct bus IDs, stable card/render links, DRM/driver/CUDA under cfg.enable.
- Remove module-generated nested specialization and WLR_DRM_DEVICES ownership.
- Generate enabled Niri KDL from tracked config plus debug.render-drm-device and validate it with pinned stable Niri.
- Export checks.x86_64-linux.flowX13-gpu-profiles with forced merged-config assertions and check-builder dependencies.
